scripts.script:
Lead with the honest question. Every lead's 'Call opener' column already has it written for that business.

"Hey, is this [owner]? This is [Your name] with [Agency]. I came across [Business] on Google and went looking for your website, and couldn't find one. Any reason you don't have one?"

Then stop talking and let them answer.

scripts.section: Whatever they say, follow their answer
scripts.script:
"Never needed one / word of mouth" → "Makes sense with [X] reviews. When people hear about you, where do they go to check you out?"
"Too busy / haven't gotten to it" → "Totally get it. Is that something you'd want handled for you, or not a priority right now?"
"Had one, let it lapse" → "What happened with it? Did it ever bring you anything?"
"I have Facebook" → "Is that where most new customers find you, or mostly referrals?"
"Too expensive" → "What did you get quoted?"
"Would it be worth 15 minutes to look at what one could look like for [Business]? I'll put together a quick mock-up first, no cost." Confirm day, time and best email.
"Hey, this is [Your name] with [Agency]. I was looking for [Business]'s website and couldn't find one. Curious if that's on purpose. Give me a call back at [phone] when you get a sec."

"Hi [Name], this is [Your name]. I called earlier: I was looking for [Business]'s website and couldn't find one. Any reason you don't have one? Happy to help if it's something you've been meaning to get to."
